derivation: adverb from the same as G3897 (παραπλήσιον);
def: in a manner near by, i.e. (figuratively) similarly

occurrences.text: Forasmuch then as the children are partakers of flesh and blood, he also himself likewise took part of the same; that through death he might destroy him that had the power of death, that is, the devil;
